assistant.answer: We reply to messages within 1 business day, usually sooner. For anything urgent, call Member services at 1-800-555-0142. In an emergency, call 911.

assistant.prompt: Can I send a photo of a form?
assistant.answer: Yes. In a new message, use Attach files to add a photo or PDF of the form. On a claim that needs a form, you can also upload it from the claim itself.
Only you and the Tornado Health team handling your question. Messages are secure, and family members on your plan can't read them unless they sign in as you.
